name: Zombie Siege VR
summary:
Zombie Siege VR - The undead are rising! Fight to protect humanity's last strongholds from hordes of ravenous zombies. Complete missions, upgrade weapons, and survive in this intense VR action game.
Key Features:
Immersive VR graphics and sound design
Responsive controls for pistols, shotguns, rifles, and grenades
Arsenal of deadly weapons and tactical upgrades
Diverse missions with increasing challenges
Are you ready to fight for survival?
